description: Equipamiento urbano – espacios públicos is a dataset listed in City of Montevideo open data catalogue, an open data portal, published or maintained by Planificación, Gestión y Diseño. Juego de datos que contiene información georreferenciada de varios tipos de equipamiento ubicados en espacios públicos. Abarca bancos, baños, papeleras, bebederos, soportes para bicicletas y relojes termómetros. Los datos se generan diariamente por lo que siempre se cuenta con la información actualizada al día anterior. Coverage: Montevideo. The portal files it under the publisher Planificación, Gestión y Diseño. Its tags are Equipamiento urbano, Espacios públicos. It offers 7 resource(s) in SHP, TXT. The portal shows 2024-05-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is dag-uy. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mvd-portal.
